title: Kidou Senkan Nadesico: The Blank of 3 Years
native_title: 機動戦艦ナデシコ Ｔｈｅ ｂｌａｎｋ ｏｆ ３ｙｅａｒｓ
overview:
The Nadesico is a precious place where you can go on being yourself. That's why we want you to see it - the blank of those three years.

A sound novel based on the Martian Successor Nadesico anime, telling what happened to the crew of the Nadesico in the three years between the end of the TV series and the movie. Every scene is fully voiced by the cast of the anime.

The choices you make shape your personality through the Personality Matrix system, and the story changes to match. Pick the right path and you might even grow close to one of the girls in the Love Love Zone.

- Two game discs plus a bonus single CD
- For 1 player, memory backup support

ナデシコは自分であり続けられる大切な場所。だからあなたに見てほしい、3年間の空白を。
